messages:
maya: Support reported a spike of tickets where customers send large mixed-dimension embedding batches and get an opaque 413. SDKs don't get guidance and users file tickets. Can we add a "preflight hint" header rather than only a hard 413?
aj: We can. Suggest a compact header `X-Embed-Preflight: dims=640;bytes=220000;units_est=4;plan=2x320;parallel_hint=false`. Advisory-only. Hosted first; Dedicated must be explicit opt-in.

kevin: Dedicated constraint: admin must opt-in and there must be an audit trail. Also we must avoid leaking exact quota numbers. Advice should be coarse estimates only.

maya: Telemetry request: add `embed.preflight.hint_sent`, `embed.preflight.hint_applied`, and `embed.preflight.split_ratio`. Tag by tenant, route, and rollout_phase. We want to see adoption and ops impact.

sara: Rollout plan: hosted canary start at 1% for 3 days, then 10% for 10 days, then 50% if no alarms. SDK flag `preflight_auto_split=false` by default.

tom: Ops concern: auto-splitting may increase request count and create hot spots. Add `est_split_requests` and `est_total_units_after_split` in header so SDKs can estimate cost and throttle.

aj: Revise header shape: `X-Embed-Preflight-v1: dims=640;bytes=220000;units_est=4;plan=2x320;est_split_reqs=2;est_total_units=5;parallel_hint=false`. Use semicolon delim for easier parsing.

kevin: Add unit tests that ensure header suppressed for tenants with `preflight_hint=false`. Also Dedicated defaults to off.

maya: Console UX: small support snippet in Agents panel: "Payload Too Large? Try splitting into N vectors of ~M bytes or enable SDK auto-splitting." And add a dashboard card showing hint_sent vs hint_applied with a tenant breakdown.

telemetry-bot: Note: create metric `embed.preflight.hint_sent` and increment by 1 per header emission. Also emit `ingest.request_multiplier` sample when a client auto-splits.

sara: Alerts: 1) adoption alert if hint_sent/embed.requests > 0.05 and hint_applied < 0.08 for 7d -> PM follow-up. 2) ops alert if ingest.request_multiplier > baseline*3 or ingest.queue_depth spikes.

tom: SDK guidance: default to showing a dev-visible message. Auto-split only when `preflight_auto_split=true` AND `est_total_units <= original_units * 1.2`. Also enforce per-tenant rate-limits to avoid ripples.

aj: Implementation plan: - implement header emission for hosted path behind feature flag - compute preflight estimate and split plan - emit metrics `embed.preflight.hint_sent` and tag rollout_phase - include `est_split_reqs` and `est_total_units` in header - add integration tests and feature flag for tenant opt-in

kevin: I'll implement Dedicated guard rails: admin toggle per tenant, audit log, and ensure no exact quotas/billing numbers in headers.

devx-bot: SDK teams notified. We'll parse `X-Embed-Preflight-v1` and provide helper for auto-splitting with cost guard.

maya: Decision recap: 1) Add `X-Embed-Preflight-v1` advisory header on hosted 413s (canary -> scale). 2) Header includes dims, bytes, units_est, plan, est_split_reqs, est_total_units, parallel_hint. 3) SDKs show warning by default; auto-split behind opt-in + cost guard + rate cap. 4) Console metrics, dashboard, and alerts added. 5) Dedicated admin opt-in only with audit logs.

aj: I'll open the PR today. Expect review tomorrow.

kevin: SGTM. Please include integration tests for tenant opt-out and header parsing.

sara: I'll create console tickets and schedule the canary once PR merges.

maya: Thanks team  will update support KB after canary results. Closing thread.
